## Changed
- Generate the omnihuman skill from the shared RunAPI recipe with contract-discovered request rules and task behavior, direct local media inputs, complete result verification, and bounded recovery.
summary: Create OmniHuman audio-to-video tasks and helper tasks for human identification and subject-mask detection through RunAPI. Use when the user asks an agent to generate talking-head video from an image and audio file, identify human regions, or detect subject masks with OmniHuman. Default to the RunAPI CLI for one-off calls; use SDKs only when integrating RunAPI into an app or backend.
